class Controller:

  return self.d.xpos[self.s._obj].copy(),self.d.xmat[self.s._obj].reshape(3,3).copy()
 def ik(self,p,R,q=None):
  q=self.q[:7].copy() if q is None else q.copy()

   self.kd.qpos[self.s._jq[:7]]=q;mujoco.mj_kinematics(self.m,self.kd);mujoco.mj_comPos(self.m,self.kd)
   cp=self.kd.xpos[self.bid];cr=self.kd.xmat[self.bid].reshape(3,3)
   e=np.r_[p-cp,Rotation.from_matrix(R@cr.T).as_rotvec()]
   if np.linalg.norm(e)<1e-5: break
   mujoco.mj_jacBody(self.m,self.kd,jp,jr,self.bid)
   J=np.vstack([jp[:,:7],jr[:,:7]])
   dq=J.T@np.linalg.solve(J@J.T+np.eye(6)*1e-5,e)
   q=np.clip(q+np.clip(dq,-.15,.15),self.s.lower[:7],self.s.upper[:7])
